title: Warm Smoky Russian Lamb Kebabs
description: A malty and light Russian dish featuring lamb kebabs grilled to perfection, served during the monsoon season. This recipe uses all-purpose seasoning and a yakimono-grill for a raw-friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono-grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together malt vinegar, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes, onion, and bell pepper onto skewers.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the kebabs for 10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
Sprinkle the all-purpose seasoning over the kebabs during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Serve the kebabs warm, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
